ang_elo.53: The old hands of S-C5 have been here since Day 1. Quentin Elo has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
boiled_potato31: They issued Edmund Potato a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
A child had enclosed a riddle in a parcel for Edmund Potato. The answer was on the back. He kept the dugout guessing until supper.

Edmund Potato of the Hegemony and Bram Archiegregor of the Concord watched a broken branch near Calvary Farm all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch. The report confirmed that the Concord held Verdel Ridge. Edmund Potato read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Edmund Potato had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Henrik Eccentricred crossed it, Edmund Potato fired. Henrik Eccentricred was gravely wounded. Edmund Potato raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Tobias Noirangelfan of the Concord (@noirangelfang).
Edmund Potato sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow.

A medic checked Edmund Potato's dressing at S-F15 and said he would be back on his feet soon. He was already trying to stand. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Edmund Potato watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F15. Edmund Potato took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Edmund Callmequeeno of the Concord (@callmequeenorea_). Edmund Potato did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Emil Potato joined S-F15 under the shadow of Edmund Potato's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Emil Potato and Tobias Hellcat argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Emil Potato measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
A replacement turned out to be from Belmonte too. Emil Potato and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
bw911k: Norbert Bwk unpacked a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts at S-F18. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Norbert Bwk let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Norbert Bwk gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Norbert Bwk tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Marrow Fen. Every version sounded like the ration bell.

Officers came to inspect S-F18. Norbert Bwk polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Norbert Bwk read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The trench wall shook against Norbert Bwk's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
An empty jam tin became Norbert Bwk's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Norbert Bwk's ear at S-F18 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Dietrich Thky of the Hegemony (@haydnburrell_9thky).
The medic looked at Norbert Bwk's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-F18. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
combat_potato1: Roland Potato found a place in S-S9 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

Roland Potato agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Roland Potato wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
The artist tried again while Roland Potato read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Someone in S-S9 asked Roland Potato about Marrow Fen. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Roland Potato got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Roland Potato sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
d4rth_bao: Day 3. The corporal put Gideon Bao beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F7, Gideon Bao listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Gideon Bao fired at a movement across the wire at R-F7. The man went down: Henrik Gavinlordofp, gravely wounded.

A bucket appeared above the Hegemony parapet at the Hanging Bridge. Teodor Yaboypolarbe fired. Gideon Bao pulled the bucket down. Later a sign went up: 'Water costs enough already.' A letter from home reached Gideon Bao before dusk. Gideon Bao read it twice and slept a little easier.
A clear shot from R-F7. Gideon Bao grazed Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin and slid back down below the parapet. Victory at Hill 304. Gideon Bao let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Gideon Bao has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included. A letter from home reached Gideon Bao before dusk. Gideon Bao read it twice and slept a little easier.
The fog lifted at noon and Gideon Bao saw the Sunken Road clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed.
Gideon Bao fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Albin "Tin" Shoes, now badly wounded.
Gideon Bao and Benedikt Ngaihte divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
mad_mr.elliott: Gustav Elliott came up on Day 6 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. The new duty roster listed Gustav Elliott as a signaller. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Gustav Elliott taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks. A letter from home found Gustav Elliott before the night shift. Gustav Elliott folded it small and kept it close.
A replacement turned out to be from Esterhaus too. Gustav Elliott and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
The line to the battery keeps going dead at the same spot near the Brickworks. Gustav Elliott suspects it is not the shelling.
The telephone wire to S-S7 was cut by shelling four times. Gustav Elliott crawled out and spliced it four times.
nikolas.kal13: Jakub Kal signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-C14 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
princeblood84: Matthias "Lucky" Princeblood walked into S-C1 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
taylociraptor: Severin "Owl" Taylocirapto joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
